items.source: fieldReference - the field to check for a null value, field reference must not be null.
items.translation: fieldReference - 要检查空值的字段，字段引用不能为 null。

items.source: expression - the expression to check for a null value, field name must not be null or empty.
items.translation: expression - 用于检查空值的表达式，字段名不能为 null 或为空。
